grading_system.evidence: In addition to academic credit accrual, students are required to develop and maintain a Personalized Learning Plan (PLP) in order to meet graduation requirements.

schedule.evidence: All 9th and 10th graders are required to be fully scheduled for eight (8) blocks. 11th graders are required to be scheduled for a minimum of seven (7) blocks. Semester 1 and semester 2 courses are listed separately; the catalog does not name a block pattern (e.g. A/B or 4x4).

credit_definition.text: Credits are listed per course: year-long courses carry 1.0 credit and semester courses carry 0.5 credit (e.g. 'Computer Science I: Creative Computing (Fall Semester) 0.5 Credit (Elective)').
credit_definition.evidence: Computer Science I: Creative Computing (Fall Semester) 0.5 Credit (Elective). Year-long courses are listed as 1.0 Credit (e.g. 1.0 Credit (English)).

course_load.min_courses_or_credits: 9th and 10th: fully scheduled (8 blocks); 11th: minimum 7 blocks; 12th: minimum 6 blocks unless approved by administration
course_load.evidence: All 9th and 10th graders are required to be fully scheduled for eight (8) blocks. 11th graders are required to be scheduled for a minimum of seven (7) blocks.

local_grad_requirements.conversion_note: Catalog states requirements directly in credits; no conversion needed. Requirements: 4 English, 3 math, 3 science, 3 social studies (incl. 1 American History), 2 world language, 1.5 PE, 1 fine art, 0.5 health, 6 electives (may include 0.25 YES per year).

notes: Local requirements beyond credits: 10 hours community service per year of enrollment; 0.25 credit Year End Studies (YES) per year of enrollment; completion of a Personalized Learning Plan (PLP) with a digital portfolio of evidence (p.7). Required local courses: Earth Systems Science in 9th grade (p.90); English 9 and English 10 sequence; Humanities Civics & World Societies (9th), World History (10th), American History (11th-12th). Up to 3 embedded credits for two years of a BTC program (p.8). Enrolling in a required course satisfies the requirement regardless of final grade (p.8). Grading: quarterly grades and a 4th-quarter-based GPA are referenced, but no grading scale is stated in the front matter. Scheduling blocks are referenced throughout (e.g. 'meets for 2 Blocks'); the block pattern is not stated.
